verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।क्रोधामाहारयत्तीव्रं तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति चाब्रवीत् ।। ७.६९.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।krodhāmāhārayattīvraṁ tiṣṭha tiṣṭheti cābravīt ।। 7.69.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard that speech of the great-souled Shatrughna, he felt intense anger and exclaimed, "Stop! Stop!"

verses.sloka: पाणौ पाणिं विनिष्पिष्य दन्तान्कटकटाय्य च ।लवणो रघुशार्दूलमाह्वयामास चासकृत् ।। ७.६९.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: pāṇau pāṇiṁ viniṣpiṣya dantānkaṭakaṭāyya ca ।lavaṇo raghuśārdūlamāhvayāmāsa cāsakṛt ।। 7.69.2 ॥

translations.english: Lavaṇa, pressing his hands together and gnashing his teeth, repeatedly challenged Shatrughna, the foremost of the Raghu dynasty.
translations.hindi: सप्तपञ्राशाः सगः . ५६१ हे राम! जब उन देवसम्मानित ब्रह्मर्षिं और राजा निमि ने अपने अपने शारीरों को त्याग दिआ, तब फिर किस प्रकार उनको -शरीर प्राप्त हुए ?

verses.sloka: तं ब्रुवाणं तथा वाक्यं लवणं घोरदर्शनम् ।शत्रुघ्नो देवशत्रुघ्न इदं वचनमब्रवीत् ।। ७.६९.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ bruvāṇaṁ tathā vākyaṁ lavaṇaṁ ghoradarśanam ।śatrughno devaśatrughna idaṁ vacanamabravīt ।। 7.69.3 ॥

translations.english: To Lavaṇa, who was speaking such words and had a terrible appearance, Shatrughna, the destroyer of the gods' enemy, spoke these words.

verses.sloka: न शत्रुघ्नस्तथा जातो यथा ऽन्ये निर्जितास्त्वया ।तदद्य बाणाभिहतो व्रज त्वं यमसादनम् ।। ७.६९.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: na śatrughnastathā jāto yathā 'nye nirjitāstvayā ।tadadya bāṇābhihato vraja tvaṁ yamasādanam ।। 7.69.4 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna declared that he was not like the others Lavaṇa had conquered, and therefore, Lavaṇa would today be struck by his arrows and go to the abode of Yama.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! उस ( देवनिर्भित ) घड़े से, जो मित्रावरुण के वीयं से हुआ था, दो तेजस्वी व्राह्मण उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sloka: ऋषयो ऽप्यद्य पापात्मन्मया त्वां निहतं रणे ।पश्यन्तु विप्रा विद्वांसस्त्रिदशा इव रावणम् ।। ७.६९.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛṣayo 'pyadya pāpātmanmayā tvāṁ nihataṁ raṇe ।paśyantu viprā vidvāṁsastridaśā iva rāvaṇam ।। 7.69.5 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna wished that the sages, Brahmins, and learned ones, like the gods witnessing Ravana's fall, would today see him slay the evil-souled Lavaṇa in battle.

verses.sloka: त्वयि मद्बाणनिर्दग्धे पतिते ऽद्य निशाचर ।पुरे जनपदे चापि क्षेममेव भविष्यति ।। ७.६९.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvayi madbāṇanirdagdhe patite 'dya niśācara ।pure janapade cāpi kṣemameva bhaviṣyati ।। 7.69.6 ॥

translations.english: Shatrughna declared that with Lavaṇa, the night-wanderer, burnt by his arrows and fallen today, there would indeed be welfare in both the city and the country.
translations.hindi: हे लक्ष्मण ! यह वोय वहां था, जो उववशी को लक्ष्य कर घड़े में रखा गया था । परन्तु था वरुण जी का

verses.sloka: अद्य मद्बाहुनिष्क्रान्तः शरो वज्रनिभाननः ।प्रवेक्ष्यते ते हृदयं पद्ममंशुरिवार्कजः ।। ७.६९.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: adya madbāhuniṣkrāntaḥ śaro vajranibhānanaḥ ।pravekṣyate te hṛdayaṁ padmamaṁśurivārkajaḥ ।। 7.69.7 ॥

translations.english: Today, the arrow released from my arm, with its thunderbolt-like tip, will pierce your heart just as a sunbeam penetrates a lotus.
translations.hindi: X६२ , संत्तरका इसीसे कुछ दिनों बाद अत्यंत तेजस्वी इच्वाकुकुलपृञ्य चसिष्ठ जी उत्पन्न हुए

verses.sloka: एवमुक्तो महावृक्षं लवणः क्रोधमूर्च्छितः ।शत्रुघ्नोरसि चिक्षेप स च तं शतधाच्छिनत् ।। ७.६९.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: evamukto mahāvṛkṣaṁ lavaṇaḥ krodhamūrcchitaḥ ।śatrughnorasi cikṣepa sa ca taṁ śatadhācchinat ।। 7.69.8 ॥

translations.english: Thus addressed, Lavana, overcome with rage, hurled a massive tree at Shatrughna's chest, but Shatrughna instantly shattered it into a hundred pieces.
translations.hindi: उन आनन्दित वसिष्ठ जी के उत्पन्न होते ही मडाराज इच्वाकु ' 'ने उनसे कहा--हे सौम्य ! आप मेरे वंश के कल्याण के लिए, मेरे कुलपुरोहित हूजिए

verses.sloka: तद्दृष्ट्वा विफलं कर्म राक्षसः पुनरेव तु ।पादपान्सुबहून्गृह्य शत्रुघ्नायासृजद्बली ।। ७.६९.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: taddṛṣṭvā viphalaṁ karma rākṣasaḥ punareva tu ।pādapānsubahūngṛhya śatrughnāyāsṛjadbalī ।। 7.69.9 ॥

translations.english: Seeing that action prove fruitless, the powerful demon Lavana again seized very many trees and hurled them at Shatrughna.

verses.sloka: शत्रुघ्नश्चापि तेजस्वी वृक्षानापततो बहून् ।त्रिभिश्चतुर्भिरेकैकं चिच्छेद नतपर्वभिः ।। ७.६९.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: śatrughnaścāpi tejasvī vṛkṣānāpatato bahūn ।tribhiścaturbhirekaikaṁ ciccheda nataparvabhiḥ ।। 7.69.10 ॥

translations.english: And the powerful Shatrughna, with his bent-shafted arrows, cut down each of the many approaching trees with three or four arrows.

verses.sloka: ततो बाणमयं वर्षं व्यसृजद्राक्षसोरसि ।शत्रुघ्नो वीर्यसम्पन्नो विव्यथे न स राक्षसः ।। ७.६९.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato bāṇamayaṁ varṣaṁ vyasṛjadrākṣasorasi ।śatrughno vīryasampanno vivyathe na sa rākṣasaḥ ।। 7.69.11 ॥

translations.english: Then, the valorous Shatrughna unleashed a shower of arrows upon the demon's chest, but that demon was not pained by them.

verses.sloka: ततः प्रहस्य लवणो वृक्षमुद्यम्य वीर्यवान् ।शिरस्यभ्यहनच्छूरं स्रस्ताङ्गः स मुमोह वै ।। ७.६९.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: tataḥ prahasya lavaṇo vṛkṣamudyamya vīryavān ।śirasyabhyahanacchūraṁ srastāṅgaḥ sa mumoha vai ।। 7.69.12 ॥

translations.english: Then, the mighty Lavana laughed, lifted a tree, and struck the brave Shatrughna on the head, causing him to faint with his limbs loosened.
translations.hindi: जे छा जब यज्ञ प्रा हो चुका, तब गु जी ने राजा निमि से कहा-- हे राजन्‌ ! में तुम्हारे ऊपर प्रसन्न हूँ ' अतएव मैं तुम्हारे इस शरीर में चेतना डाल दूँगा अर्थात्‌ तुम्हें पुनः जाजित कर दूँगा

verses.sloka: तस्मिन्निपतिते वीरे हाहाकारो महानभूत् ।ऋषीणां देवसङ्घानां गन्धर्वाप्सरसां तथा ।। ७.६९.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: tasminnipatite vīre hāhākāro mahānabhūt ।ṛṣīṇāṁ devasaṅghānāṁ gandharvāpsarasāṁ tathā ।। 7.69.13 ॥

translations.english: When that brave warrior fell, a great cry of distress arose from the sages, hosts of gods, Gandharvas, and Apsaras.
translations.hindi: उधर सब देखता भी वहाँ उपास्थत हो राजा निभि से बो ते -- हे राजर्षे ! वर माँगिए ! कि, तुम्हारा जीव कहाँ रखा जाय

verses.sloka: तमवज्ञाय तु हतं शत्रुघ्नं भुवि पातितम् ।रक्षो लब्धान्तरमपि न विवेश स्वमालयम् ।। ७.६९.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: tamavajñāya tu hataṁ śatrughnaṁ bhuvi pātitam ।rakṣo labdhāntaramapi na viveśa svamālayam ।। 7.69.14 ॥

translations.english: Disregarding Shatrughna, who had fallen to the ground as if killed, the demon, even though he had found an opportunity, did not enter his own abode.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार समस्त देव गाओं का बचत सुन, निमि को आत्मा ने कहा--हे देवताओं ! में तो समस्त प्राणियों के तेत्रो पर रहना चाहता हूँ

verses.sloka: नापि शूलं प्रजग्राह तं दृष्ट्वा भुवि पातितम् ।ततो हत इति ज्ञात्वा तान्भक्षान्समुदावहत् ।। ७.६९.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: nāpi śūlaṁ prajagrāha taṁ dṛṣṭvā bhuvi pātitam ।tato hata iti jñātvā tānbhakṣānsamudāvahat ।। 7.69.15 ॥

translations.english: Even after seeing Shatrughna fallen on the ground, Lavana did not pick up his trident; instead, thinking him dead, he carried away his prey.
translations.hindi: यह प्रार्थना सुन कर, देवताओं ने राजा निमि से कहा--त्रहुत अच्छा तुम वायुरूप हो कर भ्राणियां के नेत्रो में बिचरोगे

verses.sloka: मुहूर्ताल्लब्धसञ्ज्ञस्तु पुनस्तस्थौ धृतायुधः ।शत्रुघ्नो वै पुरद्वारि ऋषिभिः सम्प्रपूजितः ।। ७.६९.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: muhūrtāllabdhasañjñastu punastasthau dhṛtāyudhaḥ ।śatrughno vai puradvāri ṛṣibhiḥ samprapūjitaḥ ।। 7.69.16 ॥

translations.english: In a moment, Shatrughna regained consciousness, and, holding his weapon, he stood again at the city gate, honored by the sages.
translations.hindi: वायुभूतेन चरिता विश्रामार्थं मुहुमुहुः ॥१९ हद र ! बाय के रूप में प्राणियों के नेत्रा में, तुम्हारे बिचरने से, उनके नेत्र, विश्राम करने के लिए, बार बार बंद होंगे

verses.sloka: ततो दिव्यममोघं तं जग्राह शरमुत्तमम् ।ज्वलन्तं तेजसा घोरं पूरयन्तं दिशो दश ।। ७.६९.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: tato divyamamoghaṁ taṁ jagrāha śaramuttamam ।jvalantaṁ tejasā ghoraṁ pūrayantaṁ diśo daśa ।। 7.69.17 ॥

translations.english: Then he took that excellent, divine, and unfailing arrow, which was blazing with dreadful splendor and filling all ten directions.

verses.sloka: वज्राननं वज्रवेगं मेरुमन्दरसन्निभम् ।नतं पर्वसु सर्वेषु संयुगेष्वपराजितम् ।। ७.६९.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: vajrānanaṁ vajravegaṁ merumandarasannibham ।nataṁ parvasu sarveṣu saṁyugeṣvaparājitam ।। 7.69.18 ॥

translations.english: The arrow had a thunderbolt-like tip and speed, resembled Mount Meru and Mandara, was perfectly bent at all its joints, and remained unconquered in all battles.
translations.hindi: जब अरणि द्वारा शरीर मथा, तब उससे एक'महातपस्वी पुरुष उत्पन्न हुआ । मथन करने से उत्पन्न होने के कारण, उनका नाम भिथि ओर जनने अथात्‌ ऋषियों द्वारा प्रकट किए जाने के कारण उसीका नाम जनक भी पड़ा

verses.sloka: असृक्चन्दनदिग्धाङ्गं चारुपत्रं पतत्रिणम् ।दानवेन्द्राचलेन्द्राणामसुराणां च दारणम् ।। ७.६९.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: asṛkcandanadigdhāṅgaṁ cārupatraṁ patatriṇam ।dānavendrācalendrāṇāmasurāṇāṁ ca dāraṇam ।। 7.69.19 ॥

translations.english: Its body was smeared with blood and sandalwood, it had beautiful feathers, and it was capable of splitting the lords of Danavas, the lords of mountains, and the Asuras.

verses.sloka: तं दीप्तमिव कालाग्निं युगान्ते समुपस्थिते ।दृष्ट्वा सर्वाणि भूतानि परित्रासमुपागमन् ।। ७.६९.२० ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ dīptamiva kālāgniṁ yugānte samupasthite ।dṛṣṭvā sarvāṇi bhūtāni paritrāsamupāgaman ।। 7.69.20 ॥

translations.english: Seeing that arrow blazing like the fire of destruction at the end of a cosmic age, all beings were struck with great terror.
translations.hindi: चेतनाशून्य शरीर से उत्पन्न होने के कारण उस पुरुषका एक नाम विदेह भी हुआ | इस प्रकार विदेहराज जनक की प्रथम उत्पत्ति हुई । उन्हीं महातेजस्वी मिथि के वंश के राजा लोग मैथिल : -कहल।ए

verses.sloka: सदेवासुरगन्धर्वं मुनिभिः साप्सरोगणम् ।जगद्धि सर्वमस्वस्थं पितामहमुपस्थितम् ।। ७.६९.२१ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadevāsuragandharvaṁ munibhiḥ sāpsarogaṇam ।jagaddhi sarvamasvasthaṁ pitāmahamupasthitam ।। 7.69.21 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, the entire world, including gods, asuras, gandharvas, sages, and groups of Apsaras, became uneasy and approached Brahma.

verses.sloka: उवाच देवदेवेशं वरदं प्रपितामहम् ।देवानां भयसंमोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ।। ७.६९.२२ ॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca devadeveśaṁ varadaṁ prapitāmaham ।devānāṁ bhayasaṁmoho lokānāṁ saṅkṣayaṁ prati ।। 7.69.22 ॥

translations.english: The gods addressed Brahma, the great-grandfather and bestower of boons, regarding the fear and bewilderment among the gods and the impending destruction of the worlds.

verses.sloka: नेदृशं दृष्टपूर्वं च न श्रुतं प्रपितामह ।देवानां भयसम्मोहो लोकानां सङ्क्षयं प्रति ।। ७.६९.२३ ॥
verses.transliteration: nedṛśaṁ dṛṣṭapūrvaṁ ca na śrutaṁ prapitāmaha ।devānāṁ bhayasammoho lokānāṁ saṅkṣayaṁ prati ।। 7.69.23 ॥

translations.english: They declared to Brahma that such fear and bewilderment among the gods, concerning the destruction of the worlds, had never been seen or heard of before.

verses.sloka: तेषां तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः ।भयकारणमाचष्ट लोकानामभयङ्करः ।उवाच मधुरां वाणीं शृणुध्वं सर्वदेवताः ।। ७.६९.२४ ॥
verses.transliteration: teṣāṁ tadvacanaṁ śrutvā brahmā lokapitāmahaḥ ।bhayakāraṇamācaṣṭa lokānāmabhayaṅkaraḥ ।uvāca madhurāṁ vāṇīṁ śṛṇudhvaṁ sarvadevatāḥ ।। 7.69.24 ॥

translations.english: Having heard their words, Brahma, the great-grandfather and dispeller of fear for the worlds, explained the cause of their fear and spoke sweet words, asking all the gods to listen.

verses.sloka: वधाय लवणस्याजौ शरः शत्रुघ्नधारितः ।तेजसा तस्य सम्मूढाः सर्वे स्मः सुरसत्तमाः ।। ७.६९.२५ ॥
verses.transliteration: vadhāya lavaṇasyājau śaraḥ śatrughnadhāritaḥ ।tejasā tasya sammūḍhāḥ sarve smaḥ surasattamāḥ ।। 7.69.25 ॥

translations.english: Brahma revealed that the gods' bewilderment was caused by the immense radiance of the arrow held by Shatrughna, intended for the killing of Lavana in battle.

verses.sloka: एष पूर्वस्य देवस्य लोककर्तुः सनातनः ।शरस्तेजोमयो वत्सा येन वै भयमागतम् ।। ७.६९.२६ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa pūrvasya devasya lokakartuḥ sanātanaḥ ।śarastejomayo vatsā yena vai bhayamāgatam ।। 7.69.26 ॥

translations.english: Brahma further explained that this radiant arrow, which caused their fear, is the eternal weapon of the ancient god, the creator of the worlds.

verses.sloka: एष वै कैटभस्यार्थे मधुनश्च महाशरः ।सृष्टो महात्मना तेन वधार्थे दैत्ययोस्तयोः ।। ७.६९.२७ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa vai kaiṭabhasyārthe madhunaśca mahāśaraḥ ।sṛṣṭo mahātmanā tena vadhārthe daityayostayoḥ ।। 7.69.27 ॥

translations.english: This great arrow was indeed created by that great-souled one for the purpose of killing those two demons, Kaitabha and Madhu.

verses.sloka: एक एव प्रजानाति विष्णुस्तेजोमयं शरम् ।एषा एव तनुः पूर्वा विष्णोस्तस्य महात्मनः ।। ७.६९.२८ ॥
verses.transliteration: eka eva prajānāti viṣṇustejomayaṁ śaram ।eṣā eva tanuḥ pūrvā viṣṇostasya mahātmanaḥ ।। 7.69.28 ॥

translations.english: Only Vishnu truly knows this arrow, which is full of splendor, for this is indeed the ancient form of that great-souled Vishnu himself.

verses.sloka: इतो गच्छत पश्यध्वं वध्यमानं महात्मना ।रामानुजेन वीरेण लवणं राक्षसोत्तमम् ।। ७.६९.२९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ito gacchata paśyadhvaṁ vadhyamānaṁ mahātmanā ।rāmānujena vīreṇa lavaṇaṁ rākṣasottamam ।। 7.69.29 ॥

translations.english: Go from here and witness Lavana, the chief of Rakshasas, being killed by the great-souled hero, Rama's younger brother.

verses.sloka: तस्य ते देवदेवस्य निशम्य वचनं सुराः ।आजग्मुर्यत्र युध्येते शत्रुघ्नलवणावुभौ ।। ७.६९.३० ॥
verses.transliteration: tasya te devadevasya niśamya vacanaṁ surāḥ ।ājagmuryatra yudhyete śatrughnalavaṇāvubhau ।। 7.69.30 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of that God of gods, the deities arrived at the place where both Shatrughna and Lavana were engaged in battle.

verses.sloka: तं शरं दिव्यसङ्काशं शत्रुघ्नकरधारितम् ।ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि युगान्ताग्निमिवोत्थितम् ।। ७.६९.३१ ॥
verses.transliteration: taṁ śaraṁ divyasaṅkāśaṁ śatrughnakaradhāritam ।dadṛśuḥ sarvabhūtāni yugāntāgnimivotthitam ।। 7.69.31 ॥

translations.english: All beings saw that divine-looking arrow, held in Shatrughna's hand, shining like the risen fire of the cosmic dissolution.

verses.sloka: अकाशमावृतं दृष्ट्वा देवैर्हि रघुनन्दनः ।सिंहनादं भृशं कृत्वा ददर्श लक्षणं पुनः ।। ७.६९.३२ ॥
verses.transliteration: akāśamāvṛtaṁ dṛṣṭvā devairhi raghunandanaḥ ।siṁhanādaṁ bhṛśaṁ kṛtvā dadarśa lakṣaṇaṁ punaḥ ।। 7.69.32 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having seen the sky covered by gods, Shatrughna, after letting out a loud lion's roar, saw Lakshmana again.

verses.sloka: आहूतश्च पुनस्तेन शत्रुघ्नेन महात्मना ।लवणः क्रोधसंयुक्तो युद्धाय समुपस्थितः ।। ७.६९.३३ ॥
verses.transliteration: āhūtaśca punastena śatrughnena mahātmanā ।lavaṇaḥ krodhasaṁyukto yuddhāya samupasthitaḥ ।। 7.69.33 ॥

translations.english: And again, challenged by the great-souled Shatrughna, Lavana, filled with anger, appeared ready for battle.

verses.sloka: आकर्णात्स विकृष्याथ तद्धनुर्धन्विनां वरः ।तं मुमोच महाबाणं लवणस्य महोरसि ।। ७.६९.३४ ॥
verses.transliteration: ākarṇātsa vikṛṣyātha taddhanurdhanvināṁ varaḥ ।taṁ mumoca mahābāṇaṁ lavaṇasya mahorasi ।। 7.69.34 ॥

translations.english: Then, the best among archers, Shatrughna, having drawn that bow up to his ear, released that great arrow onto Lavana's broad chest.

verses.sloka: उरस्तस्य विदार्याशु प्रविवेश रसातलम् ।। ७.६९.३५ ॥
verses.transliteration: urastasya vidāryāśu praviveśa rasātalam ।। 7.69.35 ॥

translations.english: Quickly piercing his chest, the arrow entered the netherworld.

verses.sloka: गत्वा रसातलं दिव्यः शरो विबुधपूजितः ।पुनरेवागमत्तूर्णमिक्ष्वाकुकुलनन्दनम् ।। ७.६९.३६ ॥
verses.transliteration: gatvā rasātalaṁ divyaḥ śaro vibudhapūjitaḥ ।punarevāgamattūrṇamikṣvākukulanandanam ।। 7.69.36 ॥

translations.english: Having gone to the netherworld, the divine arrow, worshipped by gods, quickly returned to Shatrughna, the delight of the Ikshvaku family.

verses.sloka: शत्रुघ्नशरनिर्भिन्नो लवणः स निशाचरः ।पपात सहसा भूमौ वज्राहत इवाचलः ।। ७.६९.३७ ॥
verses.transliteration: śatrughnaśaranirbhinno lavaṇaḥ sa niśācaraḥ ।papāta sahasā bhūmau vajrāhata ivācalaḥ ।। 7.69.37 ॥

translations.english: That demon Lavana, pierced by Shatrughna's arrow, suddenly fell to the ground like a mountain struck by a thunderbolt.

verses.sloka: तच्च शूलं महत्तेन हते लवणराक्षसे ।पश्यतां सर्वदेवानां रुद्रस्य वशमन्वगात् ।। ७.६९.३८ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacca śūlaṁ mahattena hate lavaṇarākṣase ।paśyatāṁ sarvadevānāṁ rudrasya vaśamanvagāt ।। 7.69.38 ॥

translations.english: And that great trident, after the demon Lavana was killed by Shatrughna, returned to the control of Rudra while all the gods watched.

verses.sloka: एकेषुपातेन भृशं निपात्य लोकत्रयस्यापि रघुप्रवीरः ।विनिर्बभावुत्तमचापबाणस्तमः प्रणुद्येव सहस्ररश्मिः ।। ७.६९.३९ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekeṣupātena bhṛśaṁ nipātya lokatrayasyāpi raghupravīraḥ ।vinirbabhāvuttamacāpabāṇastamaḥ praṇudyeva sahasraraśmiḥ ।। 7.69.39 ॥

translations.english: Having completely struck down the terror of the three worlds with a single arrow, the great hero of the Raghu dynasty, Shatrughna, shone forth with his excellent bow and arrow, just like the sun dispelling darkness.

verses.sloka: ततो हि देवा ऋषिपन्नगाश्च प्रपूजिरे ह्यप्सरसश्च सर्वाः ।दिष्ट्या जयो दाशरथेरवाप्तस्त्यक्त्वा भयं सर्प इव प्रशान्तः ।। ७.६९.४० ।।
verses.transliteration: tato hi devā ṛṣipannagāśca prapūjire hyapsarasaśca sarvāḥ ।diṣṭyā jayo dāśaratheravāptastyaktvā bhayaṁ sarpa iva praśāntaḥ ।। 7.69.40 ।।

translations.english: Then indeed, all the gods, sages, serpents, and Apsaras worshipped him, exclaiming that fortunately, victory had been obtained by Dasharatha's son, and they were now calm, having abandoned fear, like a pacified serpent. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकोनसप्ततितमः सर्गः ।। 69 ।। Thus ends the sixty-ninth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
